youtube.title: 14 saal baad Ram laute toh Ayodhya ne kya kiya? 🪔 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Chaudah saal ka vanvaas poora hua aur Lanka par vijay ke baad Shri Ram, Sita Maa aur Lakshman ke saath Ayodhya laute. Bharat ne unka swagat kiya aur poori nagri unke darshan ke liye umad padi.

Parampara ke anusaar Ayodhya ke logon ne ghar-ghar deep jalaye aur nagri ko roshni se sajaya. Isi smriti mein aaj bhi hum Diwali par deepak jalate hain.

Katha ka strot: Valmiki Ramayan, Yuddha Kanda (sarg 127-128) aur lok parampara.
